run.command: strata bench run --profile <data-dir>\bench-2026-11-10-unsloth-ud-q4_k_xl-v0.2.13.1.json --track custom --track-notes Strata 0.2.13.1 (tag v0.2.13.1, commit 628f7495), engine 0.1.59 built from source (cmake+ninja, MSVC 19.44, CUDA 13.4, sm_120, BUILD.json source=local). Run config = plain setup defaults: --expert-profile data/expert-profile.bin, --expert-cache auto --prefill auto --kv int8 --max-context 262144, no --pool-workers and no --adapt-* values (the engine uses its own). STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP was removed from the config before this run: the engine default 7 is ON and measured 56.3 tok/s chat decode against 37.4 with the variable set to 0 on this machine (+50%). STRATA_HC_Q8 was removed too (it only applies to Metal and AMD gfx12, not CUDA). Drafter: DFlash2 from the run config default drafting=auto (--draft dflash2 --spec 6 --draft-conf 0.7, no MTP layer); the --spec 4, --spec-min-p 0.5 and --mtp entries in the config are replaced by that decision. --kv-resident 32768 is in the config but does not stream: a context of 32768 cells or fewer is not streamed and this run reaches about 16900. --vision is on; none of the measured requests used an image. --model-revision 084c631ac221016019d6e0a863afe92d90edd3b0 --quantization UD-Q4_K_XL --tokenizer-revision unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF @ 084c631ac221016019d6e0a863afe92d90edd3b0 --custom-pack Strata IQ-Pack (packs/unsloth-ud-q4_k_xl, tools/iq_pack.py, conversions.json, compat-bf16.json) with native_experts.txt v3 and index.txt; four GGUF shards in one file list; data/expert-profile.bin (expert profile shipped with the release); MTP draft vocabulary mtp/rt/draft_vocab.bin --background Windows 11 desktop: explorer, StartMenuExperienceHost, SearchHost, Edge WebView2, Firefox, Signal, Cryptomator, ArgusMonitor, ScanSnap, UniGetUI, Acronis TrueImage; about 1.4 GiB VRAM in use before the run (nvidia-smi) --build-options CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=120,CUDA 13.4,MSVC 19.44,cmake+ninja,source build,vision:gpu
